# id: PG-pg-54-research
# covers: PG 184 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek researches at the Research Bench (job); research status progress (0..1) of the first queued tech per
#   10-game-minute window at speed 10. research start any 3 queues up to 3 techs the game would
#   start now (longest first); the first is measured; progress resets to the next tech
#   when one completes (then that window's BAL2 is invalid: P1 < P0).
# verify: progress rises in every window (else no power/bench level: research status desk_level/benches);
#   own50 > none = research reads the hooked Science (ResearchBuilding::operate is not scaled by PG).
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
give Avarek "Book" 40 ~ got [1-9]
research status
power "Research Bench" supply radius 60
research start any 3 ~ started=[1-9]
research status ~ queue=[1-9]
job Avarek "Research Bench" radius 60
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 600
speed 0
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek science 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
research status ~ queue=[1-9]
research status ~ ^(?!.*power_off)
building "Research Bench" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set P0 research status ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 10 900
speed 0
@echo POST
research status ~ researchers=[1-9]
@set P1 research status ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,184,science,10,0,none,w1,research,600,${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek science 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Research Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
research status ~ queue=[1-9]
